card.name: The end of the word platelet
card.fires_on: The final piece "let" or "lets" in the word platelet, including antiplatelet and in capitals. It appears in counts, clumping, and antiplatelet effect.

modes.label: Platelet counts and recovery

modes.label: Antiplatelet wording
modes.description: The ending of antiplatelet in interaction or warning headings, often in capitals.

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of the word platelet, as in platelet count or antiplatelet.
